theorem prop_9_4_2 {x : ℝ} (hx : 1 ≤ x) (δ : ℝ) {q : ℕ} [NeZero q] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ q)
    (hχ : χ.IsPrimitive) {T0 : ℝ} (hT0 : 200 + max (10 * π * |δ|) 50 ≤ T0) (hG : GRHUpTo χ T0) :
    ‖Schar χ (fun n => ((Λ n * etaPlus (n / x) : ℝ) : ℂ)) (δ / x) -
        (if q = 1 then 𝓕 (fun u => (etaPlus u : ℂ)) (-δ) * x else 0)‖ ≤ err942N q T0 δ x * x :=

note: Lean proves it outright (no hypotheses) for H = 200 with its own, much larger error err942N (Plancherel windows below T₀, Jensen windows above, uniform Mellin bounds at s = 0 and Re s = −1/2). Erratum: The first line of (9.70) is Lemma 9.4.1's bound, and (9.66) drops f(T₀)g_χ(T₀): for ζ even at the book's H = 200, T₀ = 450 the zero sum is 1.053 times (9.66)'s right side, and with the term restored the coefficient is at least 10.3532/(2π·0.1598) + 10.3532/2 = 15.49 > 11.308 for every q, H, T₀ (about 27 at §9.6's T₀ − H = 250, qT₀ = 1.35·10⁸) (checked by `scripts/checks/proposition_9_4_2.py`).
